Hero proposition: an older woman with an expressive amethyst-purple jacket confidently directs her personal Aura from a large tablet in her own warmly lived-in Queensland home, with her adult daughter beside her as an equal conversation partner. They are making a choice about a future outing or creative activity, not posing at a table. A coherent luminous visualisation extends from the tablet: a rainbow nested horn-torus personal-context view, selected photographs and a musical memory connected by fine golden light, alongside a softly visible digital representation of a meaningful place. This is a visual metaphor for source-linked personal understanding, not a cure. Show their faces, hands and active attention clearly. Composition should balance the intimate human relationship with striking, intelligible technology and an open view toward the wider world. Rich purple and cobalt with warm gold and natural timber; plenty of neutral material contrast. Do not include a pressure chamber, medical uniforms, biometric claims or a generic wall of charts.
